title: Ammonia scavenger and glutamine synthetase inhibitors cocktail in targeting mTOR/beta-catenin and MMP-14 for nitrogen homeostasis and liver cancer.
authors: Elmetwalli, Alaa; Nageh, Aly; Youssef, Amany I; Youssef, Magda; Ahmed, Mohamed Abd El-Rahman; Noreldin, Ahmed E; El-Sewedy, Tarek
one_liner_zh: 该文研究谷氨酰胺合成酶抑制剂与氨清除剂对肝癌细胞mTOR/β-catenin通路及MMP-14的影响，核心为代谢与肿瘤治疗，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟建模内容，与本课题无关。
abstract: The glutamine synthetase (GS) facilitates cancer cell growth by catalyzing de novo glutamine synthesis. This enzyme removes ammonia waste from the liver following the urea cycle. Since cancer development is associated with dysregulated urea cycles, there has been no investigation of GS's role in ammonia clearance. Here, we demonstrate that, although GS expression is increased in the setting of beta-catenin oncogenic activation, it is insufficient to clear the ammonia waste burden due to the dysregulated urea cycle and may thus be unable to prevent cancer formation. In vivo study, a total of 165 male Swiss albino mice allocated in 11 groups were used, and liver cancer was induced by p-DAB. The activity of GS was evaluated along with the relative expression of mTOR, beta-catenin, MMP-14, and GS genes in liver samples and HepG2 cells using qRT-PCR. Moreover, the cytotoxicity of the NH3 scavenger phenyl acetate (PA) and/or GS-inhibitor L-methionine sulfoximine (MSO) and the migratory potential of cells was assessed by MTT and wound healing assays, respectively. The Swiss target prediction algorithm was used to screen the mentioned compounds for probable targets. The treatment of the HepG2 cell line with PA plus MSO demonstrated strong cytotoxicity. The post-scratch remaining wound area (%) in the untreated HepG2 cells was 2.0%. In contrast, the remaining wound area (%) in the cells treated with PA, MSO, and PA + MSO for 48 h was 61.1, 55.8, and 78.5%, respectively. The combination of the two drugs had the greatest effect, resulting in the greatest decrease in the GS activity, beta-catenin, and mTOR expression. MSO and PA are both capable of suppressing mTOR, a key player in the development of HCC, and MMP-14, a key player in the development of HCC. PA inhibited the MMP-14 enzyme more effectively than MSO, implying that PA might be a better way to target HCC as it inhibited MMP-14 more effectively than MSO. A large number of abnormal hepatocytes (5%) were found to be present in the HCC mice compared to mice in the control group as determined by the histopathological lesions scores. In contrast, PA, MSO, and PA + MSO showed a significant reduction in the hepatic lesions score either when protecting the liver or when treating the liver. The molecular docking study indicated that PA and MSO form a three-dimensional structure with NF-kappaB and COX-II, blocking their ability to promote cancer and cause gene mutations. PA and MSO could be used to manipulate GS activities to modulate ammonia levels, thus providing a potential treatment for ammonia homeostasis.
abstract_zh: 谷氨酰胺合成酶（glutamine synthetase, GS）通过催化谷氨酰胺的从头合成促进癌细胞生长。该酶在尿素循环后清除肝脏中的氨废物。由于癌症发展与尿素循环失调相关，此前尚未有研究探讨GS在氨清除中的作用。在此，我们证明，尽管在β-连环蛋白（beta-catenin）致癌激活背景下GS表达增加，但由于尿素循环失调，其不足以清除氨废物负担，因此可能无法阻止癌症形成。在体内研究中，共使用165只雄性瑞士白化小鼠，分为11组，并通过p-DAB诱导肝癌。通过qRT-PCR评估了肝脏样本和HepG2细胞中GS活性以及mTOR、beta-catenin、MMP-14和GS基因的相对表达。此外，分别通过MTT和伤口愈合实验评估了氨清除剂苯乙酸（phenyl acetate, PA）和/或GS抑制剂L-甲硫氨酸亚砜亚胺（L-methionine sulfoximine, MSO）的细胞毒性及细胞迁移潜力。使用Swiss靶点预测算法筛选上述化合物的可能靶点。HepG2细胞系经PA加MSO处理显示出强细胞毒性。未处理HepG2细胞划痕后剩余伤口面积（%）为2.0%。相比之下，经PA、MSO和PA+MSO处理48小时的细胞剩余伤口面积（%）分别为61.1、55.8和78.5%。两种药物联合使用效果最强，导致GS活性、beta-catenin和mTOR表达下降最大。MSO和PA均能抑制mTOR（肝细胞癌（HCC）发展的关键因子）和MMP-14（HCC发展的关键因子）。PA对MMP-14酶的抑制效果优于MSO，表明PA可能因其对MMP-14的抑制效果优于MSO而成为靶向HCC的更好方式。根据组织病理学病变评分，与对照组小鼠相比，HCC小鼠中发现了大量异常肝细胞（5%）。相反，PA、MSO和PA+MSO在保护肝脏或治疗肝脏时均显著降低了肝脏病变评分。分子对接研究表明，PA和MSO与NF-kappaB和COX-II形成三维结构，阻断其促进癌症和导致基因突变的能力。PA和MSO可用于调控GS活性以调节氨水平，从而为氨稳态提供潜在治疗策略。
